legalCitations.description: Allows unsworn declarations under penalty of perjury as alternative to sworn affidavits (future enhancement)
Jurat requirements - notary must administer oath and verify identity; specific certificate format required with identity verification notice

exhibitRules.instructions: Each exhibit must have a cover page with the exhibit letter (A, B, C, etc.) centered at the top. The cover page should include a brief description of the exhibit.
